about_the_game:
"If I learned swordsmanship, wouldn't I be afraid of bad wolves anymore? Perhaps I could even protect others, like Sister Alian?"

An abandoned baby girl, taken from a reed marsh by a kind-hearted nun to a nunnery, lived a carefree life for over a decade. Her daily routine consisted of vegetarianism and Buddhist chanting, never killing a single chicken, and knowing nothing of the bloody world outside.

An unexpected encounter led the girl to a knight-errant, sparking her curiosity about the world outside. Later, she followed him down the mountain, honing her martial arts and meeting all kinds of people. Through countless choices, she determined her own path and chose the person to spend her life with.

Character Introductions

Bai Yan (Default protagonist name; first name changeable, last name fixed)

A Lian: A swordsman. Lively and cheerful, a devoted foodie.

Lin Zhu: A young woman from the same town, shrouded in mystery. Always eager to compete with the protagonist in every matter.

Chu Xingzhou: Known in the martial world as the “Pear Blossom Immortal.”

Zhou Ruyue: A physician. Suffers from a leg ailment that impedes her mobility.

More characters in production.

Game Content

"Flying Flower Sword" is a text-based adventure game set in an alternate ancient world, featuring martial arts elements. Players assume the role of a young girl born in a nunnery, journeying down the mountain to explore the world, meeting various characters, facing diverse choices, and determining their path. Together, they create a legendary story.
